paragraphs: Rabbah bar Shimi. Yoma 63a. Yuhasin takes there to be two men of this name. I do not know whence he knows there were two: if because he spoke with Rav Yosef, Rava's teacher, and with Rav Pappa and Ravina, Rava's pupils, this is not conclusive; perhaps he lived long. One version has him report a teaching of Rav Hisda, or alternatively Rav Yosef (Hullin 102a). Rabbah bar Shimi said, ‘The master did not say this’—meaning Rav Yosef: there, 29b. He disagrees with Rav Pappa: Megillah 24, end of a. In Ravina's name: Pesahim 6b. He told Ravina, ‘The master explicitly said’: Kiddushin 45, beginning of b.
